# Hookpost

> Hookpost is an open-source, multi-agent AI social media management platform and Postiz alternative supporting 30+ networks, native MCP server, and Docker self-hosting.

## Core Documentation
- [Homepage](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/): Visual calendar scheduling, AI copilot, and multi-channel publishing dashboard.
- [AI Agents & MCP Server](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/mcp): Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setup for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf (npx hookpost).
- [Postiz Alternative Guide](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/alternatives/postiz): Feature matrix, pricing comparison, and 3-step migration guide from Postiz to Hookpost.
- [Buffer Alternative Guide](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/alternatives/buffer): In-depth comparison of pricing, scheduling capabilities, and API access vs Buffer.
- [Docker Self-Hosting Guide](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/docker-self-hosting): Production Docker Compose setup for Next.js, NestJS, Temporal.io, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
- [Why We Rewrote Postiz](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/why-we-rewrote-postiz): Engineering retrospective on microservices architecture, Temporal workflows, and performance optimization.
- [Claude MCP Social Media Guide](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/claude-mcp-social-media): Step-by-step tutorial for controlling Hookpost social media publishing directly from Claude Code.
- [Supported Channels](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/channels): API specifications for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, and Mastodon.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/pricing): Free starter tier ($0) and flat plans starting at ₹699 / $9/month with Razorpay (UPI, NetBanking, Cards).
- [Company & Team](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/about): About Hookstep, founder Mohan Bhanushali, mission, and product roadmap.

- [Public API Reference](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/docs/public-api): REST endpoints for posts, channels, media, and slot lookup, with auth and rate limits.
- [OAuth for Third-Party Apps](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/docs/oauth): Authorisation-code flow for apps acting on another organisation's behalf.

## Optional
- [All Alternatives](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/alternatives): Comparison pages against Hootsuite, Later, Metricool, Publer, SocialPilot, and Sprout Social.
- [Solutions Hub](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/for): Persona-specific workflows for creators, agencies, developers, e-commerce, and solopreneurs.
- [Terms of Service](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/terms): User agreement and service terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/privacy): Privacy policy and data retention practices.
- [Comprehensive LLM Specification](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/llms-full.txt): Full technical architecture, environment variables, and API specs.
